assumptions: Actual RuleBasedProvider, shared feature calculations and common entry/risk guards. No strategy or parameter selection.
Signals see only candles closed before the execution bar; decisions nominally occur +5s after the boundary. OHLC cannot resolve those five seconds or real latency.
Entry/exit fills approximate next-open/trigger plus configured spread and slippage. Historical books, queue position and market impact are unavailable.
UTC daily trade limits, coin cooldown, shared cash, lot rounding, exchange minimums, portfolio stop-risk and drawdown pause are modelled.
Stop-first on simultaneous intrabar levels; gap stops use the worse open. Liquidation at the evaluation end is artificial.
Protective intrabar exits assume executable liquidity. Known quantity/notional minimums are enforced; unliquidated dust remains marked at bid, not converted into fictional cash.

Paused accounts do not consult the provider. Failed protective exits latch and pause entries; retries use the next available bar open, a coarse approximation of live paper ticks/backoff. Successful recovery does not automatically resume.
Current surviving market universe and current exchange metadata introduce survivorship/metadata bias. No future profitability is established.
portfolioEvidence.warning: Actual rule-provider decisions, approximate historical OHLC execution. Retrospective report; small samples and current universe do not establish future profitability.

researchEvidence.method: Four fixed research presets, all reported; chronological 70/30 holdout plus three non-overlapping folds. No parameter search or strategy deployment. Research presets are not exact replays of the paper/live account strategies.
researchEvidence.warning: Research presets differ from the actual rule account. All presets shown; no winner selected. Retrospective results cannot establish future profitability.

longHorizonWindows.definitions: Rows correspond in order to windows; values correspond to columns. Complete windows require every UTC bar and the predecessor return anchor. Missing numeric metrics stay null; no older-bar backfill. Returns are close-to-close; drawdown uses the anchor and closes, not intrabar fills. Volatility is sample standard deviation of15m log returns in percent, not annualized. Correlation uses exactly paired15m log returns; zero variance is undefined even with complete data. Base volume is not quote/trade-level VWAP. Display values use10 significant digits; raw candles remain stored. Nested windows overlap and are not independent profit evidence.

marketContext.metricDefinitions: 24h/48h windows end at the latest closed UTC 15m boundary. Missing candles/return edges are not replaced by older data; incomplete metrics stay null. Volatility/correlation use close-to-close log returns. barApproxVwapLast24h weights OHLC typical price by bar volume, not observed trade-level VWAP.
marketContext.unitConvention: Legacy fields amountEur/costEur/volume24hEur are amounts in quoteCurrency; no FX conversion.
